Independent serviceTaskMatch is an independent task-matching app. It is not a government service, and users remain responsible for applicable laws and valid work permissions.




Privacy Policy
TASKMATCH · VERSION 1.0
1. Scope
TaskMatch helps clients and workers describe, negotiate and record tasks. It is not a government authority and does not itself determine legal work eligibility.
2. Identity & documents
Identity and country-specific work-eligibility documents may be stored as separate status records. “Uploaded” does not mean “verified”. Verification sources and status must remain distinguishable.
3. Conversations, photos & voice
Task chat, photos, translations, approvals and task history are used to support the current task. Voice translation must be disclosed. Same-voice/locked-voice features require explicit consent and a deletion control.
4. AI
AI suggestions can be wrong. Critical price, scope, transport, materials, legal status and safety decisions require user confirmation. TaskMatch should separate verified facts, user statements, AI inference and unknowns.
5. Local storage & backup
V1.0 keeps prototype task records locally unless the user exports, shares, restores or explicitly uses live AI. Production server retention and deletion rules must be documented before launch.
6. Safety
Users may pause or leave a task for safety. Emergency information must be confirmed for the user’s current jurisdiction; TaskMatch is not an emergency service.
